description: MCP package age risk scorer daemon. Reads mcp_server_registry via ws_query. For npm packages: GET https://registry.npmjs.org/{package_name} to fetch time.created field. Compute age_days = (now - created). Risk scoring: age_days < 7 = -25 to temporal_stability signal (brand new package), age_days < 30 = -15, age_days 30-90 = -5, age_days > 365 = +10 (established). Cross-reference: if age_days < 30 AND download_count < 10 = CAUTION_LIMITED floor. if age_days < 7 AND any threat in mcp_threat_associations = HIGH_RISK_ISOLATED floor. ws_write mcp_signal_scores temporal_stability signal for each server. ws_write mcp_risk_register age_risk_tier. Poll 86400s. Heartbeat.
